headline: Quarter shows mixed revenue growth with AI driving upside for several firms but guidance cuts and profit pressure for others.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest (Infosys 1.5%) to very strong (Coforge 53.6%). AI-related revenue rose sharply at Infosys, LTM, Mphasis and HCLTech, supporting profit expansion at the latter three. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech and Wipro, indicating uncertainty. Profit margins improved at high‑growth firms but fell at Wipro and Persistent.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI revenue grew 29% YoY at Infosys, 47% at LTM, and 66% of Mphasis contracts were AI‑led, boosting top‑line growth.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%; HCLTech and Wipro introduced modest FY27 guidance, reflecting cautious outlook.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%; OFSS posted a 47.8% operating margin, while Wipro's margin slipped to 16.5%.
